source_of_scope: User prompt supplied no separate single-method paragraph. This run explicitly selects ONE lane, MGC-88, and will stop on literal registry duplication.
lane: MGC-88: cover-conditional, locally aligned RTP-magnetic and isostatic-gravity gradient edges; no fault-catalogue feature in model
hypothesis: Independent magnetic and gravity edges that remain aligned under thick basin cover may reveal overlooked fault-related contacts beyond mapped surface traces.
non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic contact / sedimentary facies boundary; flight-line or gridding seams can also mimic geophysical edges.
registered_transform: Gaussian-derivative gradients of band 2 at sigma 2 px and band 13 at sigma 3 px. Compute signed cosine alignment and product of log-gradient magnitudes; include band 15 as cover covariate. Baseline uses only bands 2, 13, 15; experimental arm adds magnetic/gravity gradient magnitude and alignment. No catalogue geometry enters features.
single_feature_canary: Symmetric ROC AUC for each included channel, withheld whole-component pixels versus sampled noncatalogue pixels inside the same scored quadrants. Any AUC >0.90 stops modelling until leakage is resolved.
holdout: Unmodified vendor/gems57/holdout.py buffered_component_draw; seeds 20 and 21; whole 8-connected components, 3-px context buffer, label-blind 12-px quadrant boundary erosion; LOQO training uses only visible faults outside the test quadrant; exact known-pixel exclusion and vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout.py pooled DTI (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, triangular 300m); paired spatial 20km block bootstrap 1000 draws. No withheld labels are a model feature.
emission: One fixed 37654-dot target, deterministic descending model probability with 2-pixel Euclidean inhibition; masked exactly off visible/production catalogue. No score-guided hyperparameter or budget search.
promotion_gate: ALL of: safe local format, max canary AUC <=0.90, experimental HOLDOUT-DTI strictly exceeds matched raw-layer control and any comparable established best, positive paired 95% CI, surface abs(rho)<=0.90 and final dot forward-3px overlap<=0.70 against every registry raster. If a universal positive-footprint prior exists, the literal uniqueness gate is mathematically impossible and the verdict is negative; no exemption is authorized. No organizer slot is used here.
provenance_limit: The raster inputs are hash-pinned copies in owner's GitHub repos, not independently authenticated against the login-gated organizer downloads. Do not label a local score ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.
